items.title: CFTC is again probing whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement barring US users, Reuters reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC is again probing whether Polymarket broke its 2022 settlement barring US users, Reuters reports** — Reuters reports the CFTC is investigating whether Polymarket took sufficient steps to keep US users off its main overseas platform under a 2022 settlement, examining its location controls and US advertising as part of a broader probe opened earlier this year. The agency is also scrutinizing onboarding and customer protections on Polymarket's US platform, and both the CFTC and Polymarket declined to comment. items.content_text: - **Brennan Center study finds prediction market odds sway voters and most want tighter regulation** — A Brennan Center-funded study of 1,994 registered voters conducted September 21 found voters were 10 to 20 percentage points more likely to pick a candidate favored by prediction markets, regardless of polling. items.title: Pentagon bars personnel from insider trading on prediction markets in October 20 memo naming Polymarket and Kalshi, BitcoinCasinos reports
items.content_text: - **Pentagon bars personnel from insider trading on prediction markets in October 20 memo naming Polymarket and Kalshi, BitcoinCasinos reports** — Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth barred military and civilian personnel from using nonpublic information to trade on prediction markets in a memorandum dated October 20 naming Polymarket and Kalshi. Violations may bring administrative, disciplinary or criminal action, and the memo follows the indictment of a soldier accused of profiting about 409,881 dollars on Polymarket from classified information about the Maduro capture. ([BitcoinCasinos](https://www.bitcoincasinos.com/blog/2026/10/26/hegseth-memo-prediction-markets/))
